scope_guards: The canonical 0-to-7,000 range is carried forward without being combined with later scenarios.
The up-to-12,000 figure is conditional on major infrastructure decisions and is not consent.
The historical up-to-15,000 HIF scenario is not added to 7,000 or 12,000.
The A13 tunnel and new rail station are dependencies and are not assumed delivered.
Land-assembly and masterplanning funding are governance context rather than homes or title evidence.
Current park and industrial uses are kept separate from whole-area planning finality.
No policy or growth-hub page establishes exact HMLR title topology.
No score or promotion is written without exact applications, current permissions, title relations and executed overlays.
